mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.description, c.icon, c.sort_order, c.create_time, c.update_time, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) as article_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN articles a ON c.id = a.category_id AND a.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.description, c.icon, c.sort_order, c.create_time, c.update_time ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.create_time DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM categories WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.description, c.icon, c.sort_order, c.create_time, c.update_time, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) as article_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN articles a ON c.id = a.category_id AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.description, c.icon, c.sort_order, c.create_time, c.update_time ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.create_time DESC
